spatial_and_orientation_analysis: In the supplied reference the left dark appliance, central range, shelf behind/right, right counter and foreground dark surface are visible. The delivered final render preserves a broadly similar left-to-right appliance sequence and four-burner cooktop, but shows a much wider, elevated view, exposed floor platform and wall perimeter rather than the reference's close interior crop. Camera, lens, framing and object placement jointly confound these differences (reference and delivered image; /evidence/final_source/build.py:31-80,86-89).

The reference door is seen obliquely at the right opening; the student uses an unrotated rectangular leaf and separate cream opening, with no hinge pivot constructed (/evidence/final_source/build.py:68-71). Its functional swing and jamb contact are not verified.

The student foreground surface appears as a floating slab in the delivered render; its source is a single cube with no modeled support (/evidence/final_source/build.py:79-80). Occlusion and cropped reference prevent asserting the true hidden support. No aligned 3D position or angle error is established.
appearance_and_resource_analysis: The reference has mottled gold tiles and wood-like floor grain; the delivered image has individually colored flat tiles and straight plank strips, visibly coarser and less textured. build.py:6-8,15-29 creates flat Principled colors, not directional noise or an image texture; material assignment is through cube at line 10. There is no texture-coordinate or Mapping node chain in this construction, so mapping direction and scale are not applicable; plank direction comes from mesh geometry.

The reference mirror contains a reflected white cabinet; the student places the Reflected upper cabinet and inset meshes directly in front of Mirror (/evidence/final_source/build.py:59-67). The countertop uses separate thin Marble vein meshes (lines 73-78), not a marble texture. Own lights and world are specified at lines 81-85; unique albedo/lighting decomposition is not identifiable.
